title: Ticket Passenger Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A passenger type by age — adult, child, infant — used to pick the fare for a traveller. A dependant's age on the day decides which passenger type's fare is used.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: AgeFrom
fields.html:
What it is. The youngest age in this passenger type.

Example. 2

fields.label: AgeTo
fields.html:
What it is. The oldest age in this passenger type.

Example. 11

Why it matters. Keep the age ranges of the passenger types from overlapping, or the first match wins.
